title: Kardashev scale

tellings.quote: Nicolai kardashev Uh Russian astronomer back in 1964 sort of proposed during the age where Optical astronomy was becoming popular and radioastronomy is coming on to identify civilizations based on the ability of uh them to access the energy of entire star

plain: Karl Nell, a researcher, explains on Jesse Michels's podcast an idea from Nikolai Kardashev, a Russian astronomer. Nell says that in 1964, as radio astronomy was taking off, Kardashev proposed ranking civilizations by how much energy they can use, up to the full energy of an entire star. It offers a way to picture how advanced a nonhuman civilization might be.
